statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field was mapped from the 'Depreciation and amortization expense' line item in Supplementary Table 1 (Page 127), which provides a consolidated total. This figure is the sum of the separate depreciation/amortization/impairment lines listed in the primary statement: 'Depreciation and amortization of, and impairment losses on, intangible assets, property, plant and equipment, and investment property' (12,858/11,727), 'Amortization of and impairment losses on capitalized development costs' (7,209/5,184), 'Impairment losses on equity investments' (710/717), and 'Depreciation of and impairment losses on lease assets' (11,279/10,655). The supplementary table total matches this sum for both years (32,056 and 28,282).
